description_en: Imports files from an authorized OSS bucket into Alibaba Cloud Model Studio application data
description_zh: 将已授权OSS Bucket中的文件导入阿里云百炼应用数据中
kebab_example: aliyun bailian add-files-from-authorized-oss --workspace-id llm-3z7uw7fwz0vxxxx --category-id cate_cdd11b1b79a74e8bbd675c356a91ee35xxxxxxxx --category-type UNSTRUCTURED --oss-region-id cn-beijing --oss-bucket-name bucketNamexxxxx --file-details '[{"FileName":"this_is_temp_xxxx.pdf","OssKey":"root/path/this_is_temp_xxxx.pdf","ParserConfig":{},"Parser":"AUTO_SELECT"}]' --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFilesFromAuthorizedOss

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Files are imported into this workspace. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID，将文件导入至该业务空间。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the category to which the files are imported. This is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also obtain the category ID by clicking the ID icon next to the category name on the <props="china">Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Files tab</props><props="intl">Application Data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Files tab</props>. You can pass in `default` to use the system-created default category
parameters.help_zh: 用于指定文件导入目标类目。即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`。您也可以在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签</props>，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取类目 ID。此处允许传入 default，即使用系统创建的“默认类目”
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The category type. Optional. Default value: UNSTRUCTURED. Valid values:
UNSTRUCTURED: category for building knowledge base scenarios.

<props="china">

This operation does not support importing SESSION_FILE for agent application conversation interaction (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/user-guide/file-interaction). Use the AddFile operation to upload SESSION_FILE from a local source.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
类目类型，可选，默认值为UNSTRUCTURED，取值范围：
UNSTRUCTURED：类目，用于构建知识库场景。

<props="china">

本接口不支持导入用于智能体应用会话交互 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/file-interaction)的SESSION_FILE，请使用 AddFile 接口从本地上传SESSION_FILE。

</props>

parameters.help_zh: OSS Bucket的地域ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html
parameters.name: oss_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/177682.html
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

fields.help_en:
The name of the file to import. The file name must include the file format extension.
Supported formats: pdf, docx, doc, txt, md, pptx, ppt, xlsx, xls, html, png, jpg, jpeg, bmp, and gif.
The file name must be 4 to 128 characters in length.
For file upload requirements and limits, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880605.html.

<notice>If the name of the imported file is the same as an existing file in the knowledge base, the operation still returns a `Status` of `SUCCESS`, but the file is not actually imported. The existing file with the same name remains unchanged. Make sure that each imported file name is unique.></notice>
To create a data table and upload data, use the Model Studio console. This is not supported through the API
fields.help_zh:
导入文件的名称，注意后缀需要带上文件格式类型。
支持格式：pdf、docx、doc、txt、md、pptx、ppt、xlsx、xls、html、png、jpg、jpeg、bmp、gif。
文件名称长度限制4-128个字符。
对文件上传要求限制，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880605.html。

<notice>当导入的文件名称与知识库中已有文件名称重复时，接口仍会返回`Status`为`SUCCESS`，但该文件实际不会被导入知识库，已有的同名文件保持不变。请确保每次导入的文件名称唯一。></notice>
如需新增数据表并上传数据，请使用阿里云百炼控制台，API不支持
fields.name: file_name

fields.help_en: The key of the file in the OSS bucket. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273129.html
fields.help_zh: 导入文件在OSS Bucket中的键名（Key），详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273129.html
fields.name: oss_key

fields.help_en:
The parser type. Valid values:

DOCMIND: intelligent document parsing.
DOCMIND_DIGITAL: electronic document parsing.
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION: LLM-based document parsing.
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER: Qwen VL parsing.
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION_MEDIA: audio and video parsing.
AUTO_SELECT: automatic parser selection.

<props="intl">
<note>The uploaded file is parsed by using the specified parser. If you set this parameter to AUTO_SELECT, the parser configured for the category is used.</note>
</props>

<props="china">
<note>When CategoryType is UNSTRUCTURED, the parser parses the uploaded file based on the data parsing settings of the current category.</note>
<note>When CategoryType is SESSION_FILE, the system uses the default method (which cannot be changed) to parse the file content.</note>
</props>
fields.help_zh:
解析器类型。可能取值范围包括：

DOCMIND（智能文档解析）
DOCMIND_DIGITAL（电子文档解析）
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION（大模型文档解析）
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER（Qwen VL 解析）
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION_MEDIA（音视频解析）
AUTO_SELECT（自动选择解析器）

<props="intl">
<note>会以当前设置的解析器对您上传的文件进行解析，若输入AUTO_SELECT则会使用所属类目配置的解析器。</note>
</props>

<props="china">
<note>当CategoryType为UNSTRUCTURED时，解析器会根据当前类目的数据解析设置，对您上传的文件进行解析。</note>
<note>当CategoryType为SESSION_FILE时，系统将使用默认方式（不支持更改）解析文件内容。</note>
</props>
fields.name: parser

FAILED: The import to application data failed.

Only files with a SUCCESS status can be used to create or update a knowledge base
